stem:
Rectangle PQRS can be rotated (turned) onto rectangle UVST.

[Image: Rectangles UVST and PQRS]

What point is the center of rotation?
figure_description: Two adjacent congruent rectangles forming an L-like shape. Rectangle UVST is oriented vertically, with vertices U (bottom left), V (bottom right), S (top right), and T (top left). Rectangle PQRS is oriented horizontally, extending to the right from the upper portion of rectangle UVST: vertex S is at the top left (shared with UVST), R is at the top right, Q is at the bottom right, and P is at the bottom left, lying on the vertical line segment SV between S and V. Each vertex is marked with a black dot.
